rules.name: PsoriasisNailPitting
rules.description: Matches characteristic nail symptoms such as pits, dents, cracks, inflammation, or tenderness, which are strong indicators of psoriasis. Updated to handle 'noticed' and flexible phrasing like 'inflammation in my nails', and now includes adjectives like 'noticeable' or 'strange' before the symptoms. The final word boundary has been removed to allow more robust matching when sentences end with punctuation or do not strictly align with word boundaries after the symptom keywords.

rules.name: PsoriasisPalmarPlantar
rules.description: Identifies symptoms specific to palmar-plantar psoriasis, such as thickened skin, deep cracks, or severe fissures on the palms and/or soles.
rules.content: (?i)\b(?:palms? and soles?|soles? and palms?)\b.*?\b(?:thickened|deep cracks|severe fissures)\b

rules.name: PsoriasisSilverScales
rules.description: Detects the distinctive 'silver-like dusting' or 'small scales' on the skin, a classic presentation of psoriatic plaques.

rules.name: PsoriasisSkinPeelingFlaking
rules.description: Matches mentions of skin peeling or flaking, especially when localized to common psoriatic areas like knees, elbows, scalp, or fingers. Updated to recognize various ways of expressing 'skin peeling', including forms like 'skin is peeling' or 'skin has been peeling'.

rules.name: PsoriasisJointAndSkinSymptoms
rules.description: Identifies the co-occurrence of joint pain or discomfort with general skin manifestations like rashes, redness, or scales, indicative of psoriatic arthritis.

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_ExplicitVeinDescription
rules.description: Matches direct descriptions of veins or blood vessels being prominent, visible, swollen, or protruding on the legs or calves, which are strong indicators of varicose veins. Updated for flexible phrasing and to include 'calf'.

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_LegCrampsPainActivity
rules.description: Identifies cramps, pain, discomfort, or aches in the legs or calves that are often exacerbated by standing or walking, or are associated with visible veins/blood vessels. Updated for flexible phrasing and to include 'calf'.

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_LegSwellingOverweight
rules.description: Matches instances of swelling or difficulty fitting into shoes related to the legs or calves, especially when there's an explicit mention of blood vessels, veins, protruding, or being overweight. Updated for flexible phrasing and to include 'calf'.

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_LegSkinInflammationWithContext
rules.description: Captures descriptions of inflamed, red, itchy, or irritated skin/rash specifically on the legs or calves, often with mentions of veins/blood vessels or cramps. Updated to use lookaheads for order flexibility.

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_LegBruisesOrBodyImage
rules.description: Matches mentions of unexplained bruises on the legs, or feelings of self-consciousness/embarrassment related to leg appearance, often associated with being overweight.

rules.name: PsoriasisEnvironmentalFactors
rules.description: Detects skin or rash symptoms that are explicitly stated to worsen in winter, dry air, cold weather, or due to temperature changes, which is characteristic of psoriasis. Updated to include 'changes in temperature' and 'humidity' as recognized environmental factors.

rules.name: Psoriasis_ThickenedCracksPalmsSoles
rules.description: Matches descriptions of thickened skin, deep cracks, fissures, or peeling, specifically on palms and soles, especially when painful or bleeding.

rules.name: Psoriasis_FingersNailsPeelingCracks
rules.description: Matches peeling skin or cracks on fingers and nails, often accompanied by itching or pain.

rules.name: Psoriasis_FissuresCracksPalmsSoles
rules.description: Matches mentions of fissures or cracks on palms or soles, allowing for flexible keyword ordering, when pain/bleeding is not explicitly stated.

rules.name: Psoriasis_ScalyRashJointPain
rules.description: Matches general skin rash, dry, or scaly symptoms combined with joint pain, indicating psoriatic arthritis.

rules.name: Psoriasis_PeelingScalyGeneral
rules.description: Matches general descriptions of peeling, scaly, or dry skin/rash, especially on common psoriasis areas like knees, elbows, scalp, arms, legs, or chest.

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_Comprehensive
rules.description: Matches texts where veins or blood vessels, related to legs or calves, are described as swollen, protruding, prominent, noticeable, or visible, with flexible ordering.

rules.name: Psoriasis_SilverDusting
rules.description: Matches the highly characteristic symptom of 'silver like dusting' or 'silver dusting' on the skin.

rules.name: Psoriasis_ThickCrackedPalmsSoles
rules.description: Identifies psoriasis characterized by thickened skin, deep/severe cracks or fissures, often painful or bleeding, specifically on palms and soles.

rules.name: Psoriasis_NailJoint
rules.description: Matches instances where both nail issues (dents, cracks) and joint pain (pain, agony) are mentioned, a common combination in psoriatic arthritis.

rules.name: Psoriasis_SkinConditionBodyPart
rules.description: Captures common psoriasis symptoms like peeling, cracking, flaky, scaly, sensitive, or irritated skin on characteristic body parts (knees, elbows, scalp, palms, soles, fingers, back).

rules.name: Psoriasis_RashSymptoms
rules.description: Identifies psoriasis based on the presence of a 'rash' accompanied by symptoms such as itching, pain, irritation, or dryness.

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_VeinProminenceSwelling
rules.description: Matches explicit mentions of veins or blood vessels being swollen, protruding, prominent, noticeable, or visible, specifically in the legs or calves.

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_ActivityTriggeredLegPain
rules.description: Matches leg or calf pain/cramps that are specifically triggered or worsened by standing or walking for long periods of time, a common symptom of varicose veins.
rules.content: (?i)(?=.*\b(?:standing|walking)\b.*\b(?:long periods|longer i am on my feet)\b)(?=.*\b(?:pain|cramps?|discomfort)\b.*\b(?:in my |my )?(?:legs|calves)\b)

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_LegCrampsSwellingOverweight
rules.description: Matches symptoms of cramps or pain in the legs or calves combined with swelling or being overweight, indicating potential underlying varicose vein issues.

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_LegSwellingFunctionalDifficulty
rules.description: Matches leg or calf swelling that leads to specific functional difficulties like trouble with shoes or discomfort from prolonged sitting.
rules.content: (?i)\bswelling\b(?:.*\b(?:legs|calves)\b)?(?:.*\b(?:difficulty fitting into my shoes|discomfort when i sit for long periods)\b)

rules.name: PsoriasisNailDentsPits
rules.description: Matches text describing specific nail changes like dents, pits, cracks, or inflammation, by ensuring both nail and characteristic words are present, irrespective of their order.

rules.name: PsoriasisSilverDustingScales
rules.description: Identifies the characteristic 'silver like dusting', scaly spots, or flaky/scaling skin associated with psoriasis.

rules.name: PsoriasisPeelingFissuresThickenedSkin
rules.description: Captures descriptions of peeling skin, fissures, cracks, or thickened skin, especially when localized to common psoriasis areas like palms, soles, knees, elbows, or scalp.

rules.name: PsoriasisJointPainSkinRash
rules.description: Detects the combination of joint pain or agony with any mention of skin or rash, by ensuring both sets of keywords are present regardless of their order.

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_ExplicitVeinSymptoms
rules.description: Matches texts explicitly describing prominent, swollen, protruding, noticeable, or visible veins or blood vessels in the legs or calves.

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_LegCramps
rules.description: Matches texts describing cramps or cramping sensations in the legs or calves, optionally with mention of aggravating activities like walking or standing.

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_LegSwelling
rules.description: Matches texts describing swelling in the legs or calves, potentially linked to being overweight or obese.

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_LegPainActivity
rules.description: Matches texts describing pain, discomfort, aches, or difficulty sleeping in the legs or calves, optionally exacerbated by activities such as standing, walking, or exercise.

rules.name: PsoriasisNailSymptoms
rules.description: Detects psoriasis based on characteristic nail symptoms like dents, pits, cracks, or inflammation, which are strong indicators of the disease. Now also accounts for symptoms appearing before the mention of 'nails'.

rules.name: PsoriasisPalmSolesCracks
rules.description: Identifies psoriasis based on fissures or deep cracks, especially on palms or soles, which may also be painful or bleed.

rules.name: PsoriasisSkinFlakingLocation
rules.description: Identifies psoriasis by characteristic skin symptoms such as peeling, flaking, scales, silver-like dusting, or scaly spots on typical affected areas like knees, elbows, scalp, palms, soles, or back.

rules.name: PsoriasisJointSkinCombo
rules.description: Detects psoriasis when joint pain or agony is combined with general skin manifestations like rash, dry skin, redness, irritation, or scaly spots, indicative of psoriatic arthritis or widespread psoriasis. The proximity between symptoms has been increased for better coverage.

rules.name: VV_DirectVeinSigns
rules.description: Matches descriptions of abnormal veins/blood vessels (e.g., prominent, swollen, noticeable, visible) on the legs or calves. The rule is more flexible to allow for different keyword orders and an optional explicit location when the vein description is strong.

rules.name: VV_LegSymptomsActivityObesity
rules.description: Matches leg/calf symptoms like swelling, cramps, pain, discomfort, or aching that are associated with prolonged standing/walking/sitting, exercise, or being overweight/obese. The rule now allows for flexible ordering of these symptom and trigger keywords.

rules.name: PsoriasisGeneralSymptomsAndEnvironment
rules.description: Identifies psoriasis based on general skin symptoms like rash, dry skin, itching, flaking, or peeling, especially when aggravated by environmental factors (e.g., winter, dry air) or causing generalized discomfort/sensitivity.
